assumptions.statement: Hypothetical square AM14U6-based packaging target. Add 3.5 inches per side to bare frame for assumed bumper-inclusive box; assume complete stowed height 20 inches and 0.25 inch positive dimensional uncertainty per full dimension. These are design targets/reserves, not measured bounds, certified bumper construction, verified mechanism fit or team-owned hardware. No mass/power/performance claim.

unknowns: Actual team ownership, availability, fabrication capability and budget
Whole-robot packing and mechanism stowage within assumed bounding box
Bumper construction, support, coverage and rule compliance
Mass, center of mass, battery current, power and thermal budgets
Motor selection and drivetrain performance calibration
Field/event applicability and complete robot legality
Swept envelope, pitch/roll, deflection, approach and traversal
Intake, storage, release and scoring physics; no full match prediction
